Treat supplied material as a provenance-bearing candidate delta.

1. Reconstruct canonical state and authoritative sources.
2. Classify each item as present, compatible extension, correction,
   supersession, conflict, unsupported, or unresolved.
3. Check evidence, authority, mathematical scope, safety, dependencies,
   no-regression, survivor preservation, rollback, and reopening conditions.
4. Record the proposed state delta and all surviving alternatives.
5. Implement only authorized, validated changes; run relevant tests.
6. Update provenance, decisions, learning archives, residuals, hashes, and
   checkpoint state only after validation.
7. Report exact terminal states and receipts; never infer completion.
